notes: XLDHehp is a helium-4 evaporation (1 K) system on the XLD side-loading platform, not a 3He/4He dilution unit; archetype 'dilution_refrigerator' is used as the closest geometric archetype (XLD-family vertical cryostat with stacked flanges). Stages in the XLDHehp are RT, 4K and Evaporator; the dilution-fridge still/cold-plate/MXC do not exist. Configuration: 2 x PT425-ENH (each 2.7 W @ 4.2 K, 55 W @ 45 K per the Bluefors PT425 page), 3-section vacuum cans with 2-section still shield, 6 side-loading LOS ports + 3 KF40 LOS + 4 KF40 non-LOS ports, no magnet, no optical access ports (windows count 0; if the option were fitted the typical clear view is 12 mm). Outer height/diameter are NOT published: the values given in 'outer' are explicit lower bounds (experimental space) and are flagged as such in 'location'; the schema requires those fields, so they are also listed in not_found. The Bluefors press release quotes 540 mm for the experimental flange while the product page says 520 mm; the catalog follows the product page. The 1.4 Hz pulse-tube rate is the standard Cryomech PT4xx figure measured on CUORE's PT415s, not an XLDHehp-specific number.
